provenance.notes: Researched definition in tools/extract/patterns/src/apg-1.mjs. Every binding was checked against the APG page; roles and key names are cross-checked mechanically against apg-skeleton.json and aria-roles.json. Arabic name is an unreviewed translation.

roles.note: Everything needed to operate the dialog is a descendant.

roles.on: a visible close or cancel control in the tab sequence

attributes.name: aria-modal
attributes.note: Only when content outside is truly inert and visually obscured.

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.values: IDREF of the visible title; otherwise aria-label

attributes.name: aria-describedby
attributes.note: Omit when the content has structure (lists, tables, several paragraphs).

keyboard.action: Move focus to the next tabbable element inside the dialog; from the last one wrap to the first.
Move focus to the previous tabbable element inside the dialog; from the first one wrap to the last.

focus.entry: On open, focus moves inside: normally the first focusable element; a static element with tabindex=-1 at the top (title or first paragraph) when the content has structure or is long enough that focusing the first control would scroll the start out of view; the least destructive action for an irreversible step; the most used control (OK, Continue) for a simple continue-or-inform dialog.
focus.exit: Focus cannot leave by Tab. Escape or a close control closes the dialog.
focus.restore: On close, focus returns to the element that opened the dialog, unless it no longer exists or the workflow makes another element the logical next step.
focus.tabStops: The tabbable elements inside the dialog only, cycling.

variants: non-modal dialog (no trap; not covered by this page)
data.notes: Content outside must be inert (the inert attribute, or aria-hidden on every sibling branch in legacy implementations, never on an ancestor of the dialog). Not direction-sensitive. Nested dialogs: Escape closes only the top layer.
